provenance: Hand-authored pre-impl sufficiency findings per D006 (goal_type=new_feature requires hand-authored findings; the agent-based auditor routes through the quota/dispatch path that F009 repairs, so it is not run here). Each of the six objective_contract.user_journeys was walked against features.json F001-F009.

findings.description: No feature in F001-F009 implements the close-time journey-evidence visibility flow (listing each required journey and whether it has captured evidence before the goal-completion audit runs). F001-F009 are all author/lock/edit/dispatch-time scope checks; this is a distinct close-time evidence-visibility surface. This gap is DELIBERATE and operator-confirmed: the journey is recorded to encode the D065 lesson (so journey-evidence is never an afterthought again), but its implementation is deferred to a follow-up plan to keep this plan single-surface, mirroring the doctor-WARN deferral in D005. Marked low (non-blocking) because deferral is intentional and tracked, not an oversight.
findings.recommendation: Track as a follow-up plan (close-time journey-evidence coverage view). Do NOT add a feature to this plan; doing so would over-scope the plan-review plan and violate its own single-surface thesis. The non_goals entry and this finding together make the deferral explicit for the post-impl goal-completion audit.
